JUST IN: The Department of Foreign Affairs confirms that multiple Filipinos are among the casualties of a tourist bus crash on the New York State highway.

The Consulate General of the Philippines in New York is monitoring developments.

“Our thoughts and prayers go out to those affected by this incident,” the DFA says.

“Respecting the privacy of the individuals, authorities have not released further
information and instead relayed that they will be reaching out to the families of the victims directly,” the department says.

The Philippine consulate says it is ready to assist any victims who may need assistance.

For victims of the accident or their next-of-kin, the consulate may be reached at the Assistance-to-Nationals Hotline (917) 294-0196. | via @chicristina_

JUST IN | The Consulate General of the Philippines in New York said they are monitoring developments on a tourist bus accident along New York’s I-90 highway. New York State Police have reported that several of the casualties are Filipinos.

“Respecting the privacy of the individuals, authorities have not released further information and instead relayed that they will be reaching out to the families of the victims directly,” the statement reads.

The Consulate also reaffirmed its commitment to monitoring developments related to the accident and those needing support.

“For the victims of the accident or their next of kin, the Consulate can be reached at the Assistance-to-Nationals Hotline (917) 294-0196,” the statement added. | via Katrina Manubay

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI

🚦 TRAFFIC ADVISORY – HYDERABAD MARATHON 2025 🏃‍♂️🏃‍♀️

📅 Sunday, 24th August 2025
🕔 5:00 AM – 11:30 AM

The 14th Hyderabad Marathon will be held across major city roads. Traffic restrictions & diversions will be in place in Cyberabad limits.

📍 Event Routes
* 42K / 21K → People’s Plaza, Necklace Road
* 10K Run → Hitex Grounds, Madhapur
* Culmination → Gachibowli Stadium

⚠️ Key Restrictions
* 🚫 Kothaguda ↔ Cyber Towers (till 7:15 AM)
* 🚫 Indiranagar ↔ HCU Gate No.2 (till 11:30 AM)
* 🚫 Lemon Tree ↔ Cyber Towers (till 8:00 AM)
* 🚫 IKEA ↔ Cyber Towers (till 8:00 AM)
* 🚫 Road No.45 Flyover & Cable Bridge (till 8:30 AM)

✅ Alternate Routes
Use ORR, Rolling Hills, IKEA Flyover, Biodiversity Flyovers, Madhapur Main Road & other suggested diversions.

🙏 Public Appeal
Commuters are advised to avoid restricted stretches & plan travel accordingly. Kindly cooperate with Cyberabad Traffic Police.

Joint Commissioner of Police, Traffic – Cyberabad
